title: BI-DIRECTIONAL BIAS ATTRIBUTION: DEBIASING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS WITHOUT MODIFYING PROMPTS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using multiple-choice stereotype preference tasks (StereoSet), question-answering accuracy in ambiguous versus disambiguated contexts (BBQ), cloze-style demographic pronoun/modifier prediction (WinoBias), differences in true positive rates for profession prediction across demographic groups (Bias-in-Bios), and natural language inference probabilities on templates with gendered and occupational words (Bias-NLI).

Evaluated using multiple-choice stereotype preference tasks measuring the proportion of stereotypic versus anti-stereotypic choices (StereoSet) and accuracy on question-answering tasks under ambiguous and disambiguated contexts (BBQ).
